relevant_laws.quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation_conditions: the subject is approaching an intersection
another vehicle has already entered the intersection from a different highway
the intersection is not controlled by official traffic-control devices
exceptions: intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices, unless the signal is inoperative (the subsection-4 case)
vehicles approaching from opposite directions where one is making or intending a left turn
reason.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the other vehicle's entry precedes the subject's; that order is the whole test
the duty lasts while the other vehicle is in the intersection

reason.title: Vehicle approaching or entering intersection (1)
